name: Laser hair-growth cap
summary: FDA-cleared low-level light devices measurably improve density in pattern hair loss.
note: Per the AAD: helps, but won’t restore a full head of hair.

name: Laser comb
summary: Same photobiomodulation idea, cheaper and slower to use.

name: Scalp massager
summary: Feels incredible. Will not regrow hair.

name: Scalp microneedling roller
summary: Marketed to boost minoxidil response; home evidence is thin.

name: Hair fibers
summary: Instant density illusion. The single best cosmetic trick for thinning hair.

name: Hairline concealer / powder
summary: Fills the hairline and part visually.

name: Thickening spray
summary: Fatter-looking strands until the next wash.

name: Pro clippers + edge trimmer
summary: A sharp lineup and maintained cut is a top-3 ROI purchase, period.

name: Blow dryer + round brush
summary: Root lift and volume that flat air-drying never gives you.

name: Silk pillowcase
summary: Less friction on hair and skin overnight. Modest but cheap.

name: Precision beard trimmer
summary: Length control and symmetry — the foundation of every good beard.

name: Beard shaping guide
summary: Consistent cheek and neck lines every time.

name: Safety razor
summary: Closer shave, fewer ingrowns than cartridge razors for many.

name: Beard oil
summary: Softens and conditions; fixes the scratchy look.

name: Beard balm
summary: Shape and flyaway control that holds all day.

name: Heated beard straightener
summary: Turns wiry chaos into a deliberate beard.

name: Beard dye
summary: Evens patchy color, hides gray.

name: Brow tweezers + scissors
summary: Clean brows change the whole eye area. Don’t over-pluck.

name: Brow tint kit
summary: Darker brows read as denser brows.

name: Brow lamination kit
summary: Redirects brow hairs up and out for weeks.

name: Clear brow gel
summary: Holds the shape all day. Cheapest item on this list that people notice.

name: Eyelash curler
summary: Opens the eyes instantly.

name: Lash lift kit
summary: Weeks-long lash curl.
note: Eye-area chemistry — follow instructions exactly; irritation risk.

name: Beard growth roller
summary: If anything grows beard, it’s the minoxidil people use alongside it — not the roller.

name: IPL hair removal device
summary: Clinical trials show real, lasting hair-count reduction. One of the most credible device categories.
note: Works best with light skin + dark hair; not suitable for every skin tone.

name: Home laser hair removal
summary: Diode-laser cousins of IPL; similar caveats.

name: Electric body groomer
summary: Chest, abs, back — trimmed, not bare.

name: Nose + ear trimmer
summary: Nobody should ever see nose hair. $15 solves it forever.

name: Epilator
summary: Pulls from the root — weeks of smooth, at the cost of some pain.

name: Wax kit
summary: Weeks of hair-free skin.

name: Depilatory cream
summary: Dissolves surface hair painlessly. Patch-test first.
